g.text: Every node/edge is traceable to a completed, ledger-graded hypothesis module. Solid = this project's own findings (Moderate grade throughout);
dashed = literature-derived or externally-unvalidated links. Bracketed subtitles report each node's independent-cohort replication tag (H5), computed
directly from h5a/h5b's committed concordant_direction/significant columns -- not asserted narratively. Full per-cohort P-values in Fig. 5/README.
Figure 6. Evidence-driven systems synthesis (H1-H2-H4), with H5 replication status
H0 (neutrophil recoverability) and H3 (omitted) are not part of this ligand/regulatory network and are not shown.
H2-secondary, H4-secondary, and H4-communication (all Exploratory or Negative-finding) are deliberately not diagrammed to avoid
overstating their confidence -- see 09_synthesis/README.md and the module READMEs for their full, unabridged treatment.
CXCL8/CXCR1/CXCR2 do not appear in H1, H4, or H5c's committed tables and are therefore absent from this figure by construction,
not by omission -- see 09_synthesis/README.md's section on the post-hoc CXCL8-CXCR1/2 check.
